fact_previews: The proposal is for a video-based job recruitment app called CMe.
CMe aims to address challenges applicants face when using traditional CVs.
The app allows job seekers to record a 60-second video to apply for jobs.
CMe includes features for tracking job applications.
Employers can create job listings and post videos through the CMe app.
